svg.text: Entity-Relationship Diagram (Part 1): Catalog, Wanted Posts & Messaging
Crow's Foot notation reconciled with Alembic migrations 0001 and 0003 (main@ecc22d2)
|| = Exactly One o| = Zero or One o< = Zero or Many Dashed Line = Optional Non-Identifying Reference | Migration 0003 enforces non-null unique client_msg_id per sender.
